Liebermann’s text corrected against Gesetze I, p. 385: “Sit nomen Domini benedictum ex hoc nunc et usque in seculum!” → “Sit nomen Domini benedictum ex hoc nunc et usque in seculum! (expanded letters in italics: en, omi, ulu)”.
The modern editor’s translation corrected against Whitelock, p. 484: “Epilogue.” → “∅”.

div.head: Northu Epilog.
div.ab: Sit nomen Domini benedictum ex hoc nunc et usque in seculum!
Sit nomen Domini benedictum ex hoc nunc et usque in seculum.
Der Name des Herrn sei gepriesen von jetzt und bis in Ewigkeit!
Blessed be the name of the Lord from this time forth and for evermore!
Blessed be the name of the Lord from now and into eternity.
Blessed be the name of the Lord, from henceforth now and forever.
Blessed be the name of the Lord, from henceforth now and forever.
